constraints.name: activity_assignments_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (ended_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'finished'::text) AND (ended_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: internal_conversations_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((kind = 'group'::text) AND (sector_id IS NOT NULL) AND (pair_key IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'direct'::text) AND (sector_id IS NULL) AND (pair_key IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: messages_check
constraints.def: CHECK ((((sender_type = 'system'::text) AND (sender_id IS NULL)) OR ((sender_type <> 'system'::text) AND (sender_id IS NOT NULL))))
